<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>

<head>
	<meta http-equiv="content-type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">
	<title>Home</title>
	<!-- Include Bootstrap CSS -->
	<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/3.3.7/css/bootstrap.min.css">
	<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">

	<!-- Include Carousel Style -->
	<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@9/swiper-bundle.min.css">

	<!-- Include Fonts -->
	<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
	<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
	<link
		href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Condensed:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap"
		rel="stylesheet">
		
		<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
      <!--Favicon-->
     <link rel="icon" href="https://a-hub-webapp-content.s3.amazonaws.com/AHUB/content/Assets/favicon/b33ea756c09b41a5a31a2ec7e4f6a882.png" type="image/png">

	<!-- Styles -->
	<style>
		:root {
			--primary-highlight-color: #ee8821;

			--heading-font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
			--body-font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
		}

		* {
			font-family: var(--body-font-family);
		}

		html,
		body {
			scroll-behavior: smooth;
		}

		body {
			display: flex;
			flex-direction: column;
			min-height: 100vh;
		}

		.wrapper {
			flex: 1;
		}

		.footer {
			margin-top: auto;
		}

		h1,
		h2,
		h3,
		h4,
		h5,
		h6 {
			font-family: var(--heading-font-family);
		}

		section {
			/* padding-bottom: 50px; */
		}

		.navbar-nav>li,
		.navbar-nav>li>a {
			color: #2a2a2a !important;
			font-size: 16px;
			transition: all .2s ease-in-out;
		}

		.navbar-nav>li>a:first-letter {
			color: var(--primary-highlight-color) !important;
			/* font-weight: bold; */
			text-transform: capitalize;
			content: "ā";
			font-variant: historical-forms;
			text-transform: lowercase !important;
			font-family: var(--heading-font-family);
			font-size: 18px;
		}

		.navbar-nav>li>a>.caret {
			margin-left: 5px;
		}

		.navbar-nav>.dropdown {
			margin: 0 6px;
		}

		.navbar-nav>.dropdown:hover .dropdown-menu {
			background-color: #1d1d1d;
			display: block;
			color: #535353;
			transition: all .15s ease-in-out;
			width: 230px;
			/* background-color: inherit; */
		}

		.navbar-nav>.dropdown .dropdown-menu>li>a {
			padding: 8px 20px;
			transition: all .15s ease-in-out;
			color: #bebebe;
		}

		.navbar-nav>.dropdown .dropdown-menu>li>a:hover {
			/* color: var(--primary-highlight-color) !important; */
			/* padding-left: 20px;
			margin-left: -10px; */
			color: #f0f0f0;
			background-color: inherit;
		}

		.nav,
		.navbar-nav {
			float: right !important;
		}

		.navbar {
			background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);
			border: none;
			position: fixed;
			top: 0;
			width: 100%;
			z-index: 1000;
		}

		.navbar>.container-fluid {
			background-color: #fff;
			border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px;
			box-shadow: 0px 0px 3px rgb(197, 197, 197);
			margin-bottom: 0px !important;
			margin: 0 auto;
		}

		.navbar>.container-fluid>.row {
			margin: 0 5px !important;
		}

		.navbar-header {
			margin: 12px 0;
			padding: 0;
			width: fit-content !important;
		}

		.navbar-header>img {
			height: 50px;
		}

		.navbar-collapse {
			padding: 0;
		}

		.scroll-down {
			position: absolute;
			bottom: 10px;
			left: 50%;
			transform: translateX(-50%);
			z-index: 1;
			display: block;
			width: 40px;
			height: 40px;
			line-height: 40px;
			text-align: center;
			border-radius: 50%;
			background-color: #ee8821;
			color: #fff;
		}

		.scroll-up {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 10px;
            left: 95%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            z-index: 1;
            display: none;
            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;
            line-height: 28px;
            text-align: center;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background-color: #878787;
            color: #fff;
            
        }

        .scroll-up:hover{
            background: #000;
            opacity: .8;
            color: #fff;
        }

		.section-link {
			display: block;
			width: 30px;
			height: 30px;
		}

		.section-link i {
			display: block;
		}

		/* To hide the link on the top of the page */
		.section-link[href="#approach"] {
			display: none;
		}

		.dropdown-menu.crud {
			min-width: 150px;
			padding: 5px 0;
			background-color: #fff;
			border: 1px solid #ddd;
			box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.175);
		}

		/* Style the dropdown links */
		.dropdown-menu.crud a {
			display: block;
			padding: 5px 15px;
			color: #333;
			font-size: 14px;
			font-weight: normal;
			line-height: 1.42857143;
			text-align: left;
			white-space: nowrap;
		}

		/* Style the dropdown links on hover */
		.dropdown-menu.crud a:hover {
			background-color: #f5f5f5;
		}

		/* Style the dropdown divider */
		.dropdown-menu.crud .divider {
			margin: 5px 0;
			border: none;
			height: 1px;
			background-color: #ddd;
		}

		/* Style the dropdown header */
		.dropdown-menu.crud .dropdown-header {
			padding: 3px 15px;
			font-size: 12px;
			color: #777;
			text-transform: uppercase;
		}

		/* Style the dropdown caret */
		.dropdown-menu.crud .caret {
			display: inline-block;
			width: 0;
			height: 0;
			margin-left: 2px;
			vertical-align: middle;
			border-top: 4px solid;
			border-right: 4px solid transparent;
			border-left: 4px solid transparent;
		}

		.header {
			/* margin: 120px auto 60px auto; */
			/* width: 940px; */
			object-fit: cover;
			object-position: center;
		}

		.header-viewfinder {
			display: flex;
			height: 600px;
			width: 940px;
			position: absolute;
			z-index: 10;
		}

		.header-viewfinder-left,
		.header-viewfinder-right {
			border-radius: 4px;
			border-style: solid;
			border-width: 5px;
			height: 90%;
			width: 50%;
		}

		.header-viewfinder-left {
			border-color: #4285e8;
		}

		.header .swiper-button-prev {
			display: none;
			color: #4285e8 !important;
		}

		.header-viewfinder-right {
			border-color: #4cb84f;
		}

		.header .swiper-button-next {
			display: none;
			color: #4cb84f !important;
		}

		.header-viewfinder-divider {
			background-color: #fff;
			margin: 0 -5px;
			width: 40px;
			z-index: 11;
		}

		.header .swiper-button-next,
		.header .swiper-button-prev {
			text-shadow: 1px 1px 4px rgba(29, 29, 29, 0.884);
		}

		.swiper-scrollbar-drag {
			display: none;
			background: #fff !important;
		}

		.header-carousel {
			border-radius: 4px;
			position: relative;
			/* top: 20px; */
			height: 700px;
			z-index: 50;
		}

		.header-carousel-slide {
			position: relative;
			height: 500px;
		}

		.header-carousel-slide-image {
			max-width: 100%;
			width: 100%;
			max-height: 650px;
			object-fit: cover;
			object-position: center;
			/* position: relative; */
			z-index: 54;
		}

		.header-carousel-slide-overlay {
			align-items: center;
			/* backdrop-filter: blur(0px); */
			display: flex;
			height: 100%;
			/* background-color: rgba(114, 114, 114, 0.586); */
			position: relative;
			justify-content: center;
			transition: all .2s ease-in-out;
			width: 100%;
			z-index: 55;
			/* display: none; */
		}

		.header-carousel-slide-overlay:hover {
			/* backdrop-filter: blur(5px); */
		}

		.header-carousel-slide-overlay>h1 {
			color: #fff;
			line-height: 1.4;
			font-size: 55px;
			margin: 0;
			padding: 10%;
			/* text-align: center; */
			text-shadow: 1px 1px 4px rgba(29, 29, 29, 0.884);
		}

		/* .carousel {
			width: 100%;
            height: calc(100vh - 75px);
            margin-top: 75px
		}

		.carousel-inner {
			width: 100%;
			height: 100%;
			object-fit: cover;
		}

		.carousel img {
			position: absolute;
			left: 0;
			top: 0;
			transition: opacity 0.5s ease-in-out;
		}

		.carousel img.active {
			opacity: 1;
		} */

		/* @media (min-width: 1200px) */
		.container {
			width: 100%;
			padding: 0px;
		}

		.dropdown-toggle {
			text-transform: lowercase !important;
			margin: 0px 20px;
			padding: 26px 0px !important;
		}

		/* .dropdown-heading::first-letter {
			text-transform: lowercase !important;
			color: var(--primary-highlight-color) !important;
		} */

		.item {
			height: 900px;
			opacity: 0.6;
		}

		.row {
			margin: 20px !important;
		}

		.message {
			padding-top: 10px;
			display: flex;
			flex-direction: column;
			margin: 10px auto 50px auto;
			width: 100%;
		}

		.visitor-carousel {
			margin: 30px 0;
			width: 100%;
		}

		.visitor-carousel-slide {
			align-items: center;
			background-color: #f6f6f6;
			border-radius: 4px;
			box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 1px 1px 8px 0px;
			display: flex;
			justify-content: space-between;
			margin: 35px auto 8px auto;
			padding: 10px 10px 10px 15px;
			width: 330px;
		}

		.visitor-carousel-slide-image {
			--visitor-carousel-slide-image-size: 120px;
			border-radius: 50%;
			height: var(--visitor-carousel-slide-image-size);
			width: var(--visitor-carousel-slide-image-size);
			position: relative;
			bottom: calc(var(--visitor-carousel-slide-image-size) / 3);
			margin-bottom: calc(0px - calc(var(--visitor-carousel-slide-image-size) / 3));
		}

		.visitor-carousel-slide-content {
			margin-right: 15px;
		}

		.visitor-carousel-slide-content-title {
			font-size: 20px;
			font-weight: 600;
			margin-bottom: 3px;
		}

		.visitor-carousel-slide-content-desc {
			font-size: 14px;
			margin-bottom: 10px;
		}

		.visitor-carousel .swiper-pagination-bullet-active {
			background-color: #f68530;
		}

		.visitor-carousel-pagination-row {
			align-items: center;
			display: flex;
			justify-content: center;
			margin-top: 30px;
			width: 100%;
		}

		.visitor-carousel-pagination-row>.swiper-button-prev,
		.visitor-carousel-pagination-row>.swiper-button-next,
		.visitor-carousel-pagination-row>.swiper-pagination {
			margin-top: 0 !important;
			position: initial !important;
		}

		.visitor-carousel-pagination-row>.swiper-button-prev,
		.visitor-carousel-pagination-row>.swiper-button-next {
			height: 30px !important;
			width: 30px !important;
		}

		.visitor-carousel-pagination-row>.swiper-button-prev::after,
		.visitor-carousel-pagination-row>.swiper-button-next::after {
			color: #f68530 !important;
			font-size: 26px !important;
			font-weight: bold;
		}

		.visitor-carousel-pagination-row>.swiper-pagination {
			width: 150px !important;
			line-height: 8px !important;
		}

		.approach {
			display: contents;
			/* flex-direction: column; */
			margin: 0 auto;
			max-width: 900px;
		}

		.approach:first-child {
			margin-top: 60px;
		}

		.approach:first-child h2 {
			margin: 0;
		}

		.approach:first-child br {
			display: none;
		}

		.main-content {
			display: flex;
			margin-top: 20px;
			margin-bottom: 10px;
		}

		.heading {
			font-size: 26px;
			line-height: 26px;
			font-weight: 800;
			color: #ffffff;
			height: 170px;
		}

		.info {
			font-size: 16px;
			font-weight: normal;
			margin-top: 5px;
		}

		.main-heading {
			padding: 20px;
			width: 50%;
		}

		.main-heading :last-child {
			height: min-content;
		}

		.heading-title-link {
			font-family: var(--heading-font-family);
		}

		.btn.btn-primary {
			background-color: #fff !important;
			border: 2px solid #49bea9;
			color: #49bea9;
			font-family: var(--body-font-family) !important;
			font-weight: 600;
			transition: all .2s ease-in-out;
		}

		.btn.btn-primary:hover {
			color: #289c86;
			border: 2px solid #289c86;
		}

		.center-of-excellence {
			display: flex;
			flex-direction: column;
			margin: 80px auto 0 auto;
		}

		.center-of-excellence>.container {
			margin-bottom: 10px;
		}

		.center-of-excellence-cards>.row {
			display: flex;
			justify-content: center;
			margin-top: 15px !important;
		}

		.center-of-excellence-cards>.row>div {
			margin: 0 5px;
		}

		.container1 {
			width: fit-content;
		}

		.container1>img {
			object-fit: contain;
			object-position: center;
			height: 200px;
			width: 200px;
		}

		.image {
			display: block;
			width: 50%;
			height: 70%;
		}

		.overlay {
			position: absolute;
			top: 0;
			bottom: 0;
			left: 0;
			right: 0;
			opacity: 0;
			padding: 15px;
			transition: 0.3s ease;
			background-color: rgba(26, 31, 32, 0.08);
		}

		.overlay-inner {
			background-color: rgba(26, 31, 32, 0.8);
			;
			height: 100%;
			width: 100%;
		}

		.container1:hover .overlay {
			opacity: 1;
		}

		.container1 .overlay .text {
			color: RGB(246, 133, 48);
			font-size: 22px;
			transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
		}

		.container2:hover .overlay {
			backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
			background-color: #f0f0f0
		}

		.container2 .overlay .text {
			color: RGB(246, 133, 48);
			font-size: 22px;
			text-transform: uppercase;
			transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
		}

		.text {
			color: rgb(193, 106, 0);
			font-size: 20px;
			position: absolute;
			font-weight: bold;
			top: 50%;
			left: 50%;
			-webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
			-ms-transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
			transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
			text-align: center;
		}

		.incubators {
			display: flex;
			margin: 0;
		}

		.incubators-header {
			margin-right: 80px;
		}

		.incubator-tiles-container {
			--mosaic-tile-spacing: 35px;
			--mosaic-tile-size: 280px;
			max-width: 1150px;
		}

		@media only screen and (max-width: 1650px) {
			.incubators-header {
				margin-right: 20px;
			}

			.incubator-tiles-container {
				--mosaic-tile-spacing: 35px;
				--mosaic-tile-size: 250px;
				max-width: 1000px;
			}
		}

		@media only screen and (max-width: 1400px) {
			.incubators-header {
				margin-right: 20px;
			}

			.incubator-tiles-container {
				--mosaic-tile-spacing: 35px;
				--mosaic-tile-size: 230px;
				max-width: 900px;
			}
		}

		@media only screen and (max-width: 1300px) {
			.incubators-header {
				margin-right: 0;
			}

			.incubators {
				flex-direction: column;
			}
		}

		.card {
			box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
			transition: 0.3s;
			width: 40%;
		}

		.card:hover {
			box-shadow: 0 8px 16px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
		}

		.card-container {
			padding: 2px 16px;
		}

		.event-zoom {
			overflow: hidden;
			margin: 0 auto;
		}

		.event-zoom img {
			transition: 0.5s all ease-in-out;
		}

		.event-zoom:hover img {
			transform: scale(1.2);
		}

		.image-zoom-container {
			overflow: hidden;
		}

		.image-zoom-container img {
			transition: 0.3s all ease;
		}

		.image-zoom-container:hover img {
			transform: scale(1.05);
		}

		.thumbnail {
			margin-bottom: 0 !important;
			border: 0 !important;
		}

		.portfolio {
			display: flex;
			flex-direction: column;
			margin: 80px auto 25px auto;
			max-width: 900px;
			text-align: center;
		}

		.portfolio-tiles-container {
			--mosaic-tile-spacing: 30px;
			--mosaic-tile-size: 210px;
		}

		.mosaic-tile-row {
			align-items: center;
			display: flex;
		}

		.mosaic-tile-col {
			align-items: center;
			display: flex;
			flex-direction: column;
		}

		.mosaic-tile {
			margin: calc(var(--mosaic-tile-spacing) / 2);
			overflow: hidden;
			position: relative;
		}

		.mosaic-tile img {
			height: 100%;
			object-fit: cover;
			object-position: center;
			width: 100%;
		}

		.mosaic-tile-sm {
			--mosaic-tile-sm-tile-count: 1;
			--mosaic-tile-sm-size-no-spacing: calc(var(--mosaic-tile-size) * var(--mosaic-tile-sm-tile-count));
			--mosaic-tile-sm-size: calc(var(--mosaic-tile-spacing) * calc(var(--mosaic-tile-sm-tile-count) - 1) + var(--mosaic-tile-sm-size-no-spacing));

			height: var(--mosaic-tile-sm-size);
			width: var(--mosaic-tile-sm-size);
		}

		.mosaic-tile-sm-tall {
			--mosaic-tile-sm-height-tile-count: 2;
			--mosaic-tile-sm-height-size-no-spacing: calc(var(--mosaic-tile-size) * var(--mosaic-tile-sm-height-tile-count));
			--mosaic-tile-sm-height-size: calc(var(--mosaic-tile-spacing) * calc(var(--mosaic-tile-sm-height-tile-count) - 1) + var(--mosaic-tile-sm-height-size-no-spacing));

			--mosaic-tile-sm-width-tile-count: 1;
			--mosaic-tile-sm-width-size-no-spacing: calc(var(--mosaic-tile-size) * var(--mosaic-tile-sm-width-tile-count));
			--mosaic-tile-sm-width-size: calc(var(--mosaic-tile-spacing) * calc(var(--mosaic-tile-sm-width-tile-count) - 1) + var(--mosaic-tile-sm-width-size-no-spacing));

			height: var(--mosaic-tile-sm-height-size);
			width: var(--mosaic-tile-sm-width-tile-count);
		}

		.mosaic-tile-md {
			--mosaic-tile-md-tile-count: 2;
			--mosaic-tile-md-size-no-spacing: calc(var(--mosaic-tile-size) * var(--mosaic-tile-md-tile-count));
			--mosaic-tile-md-size: calc(var(--mosaic-tile-spacing) * calc(var(--mosaic-tile-md-tile-count) - 1) + var(--mosaic-tile-md-size-no-spacing));

			height: var(--mosaic-tile-md-size);
			width: var(--mosaic-tile-md-size);
		}

		.mosaic-tile:hover .overlay {
			opacity: 1;
		}

		.mosaic-tile .overlay .text {
			color: #f68530;
			font-size: 22px;
			transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
		}

		.thumbnail>img {
			max-height: 200px;
			max-width: 240px;
		}

		.event {
			display: flex;
			flex-direction: column;
			margin: 0 auto 25px auto;
			max-width: 1200px;
			text-align: center;
		}

		.event-cards>.row {
			display: flex;
			justify-content: center;
			margin-top: 20px !important;
		}

		.event-cards>.row>div {
			border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px;
			padding: 0;
			margin: 0 15px !important;
			height: 480px !important;
		}

		/* .event-cards>.row>div>.zoom {
			border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
		}

		.event-cards>.row>div>.zoom>img {
			object-fit: cover;
			object-position: center;
		} */
